text:
Some shoppers pay with banknotes and coins, while others tap a card or a phone, and opinions differ on whether cash or digital payments are better. This essay will consider both views before explaining my own opinion.

On the one hand, supporters of cash argue that it offers privacy and control. Notes work without power and make spending visible. A person who takes a fixed amount of cash to the market each week, for example, can see exactly how much is left and is less likely to overspend. Cash leaves no digital record, which protects privacy, and it can be used by people without bank accounts, such as children, tourists and the elderly. During power cuts or system failures, cash is often the only way to buy essentials. It also avoids card fees, which small traders must pay for every transaction.

On the other hand, supporters of digital payments argue that they offer speed and records. Cards and apps are faster, safer from theft and easier to track, but they depend on technology. A traveller who pays by phone abroad, for example, avoids carrying large sums and exchanging currency, and a shop assistant does not have to count change. Digital payments produce statements that help people to budget and make it harder to evade tax. They also allow online shopping and instant transfers to friends and family. However, cyberattacks, outages and the risk of overspending are drawbacks. Having both options is practical. People can use digital payments for convenience and keep some cash for emergencies and for situations where privacy or reliability matter.

In conclusion, both views have merit. Overall, I prefer digital payments for everyday use, but I believe that cash should remain widely accepted.

analysis.type_vi: Discuss both views: tiền mặt hay thanh toán số

plan.think: Mở bài nêu người trả bằng tiền giấy, người chạm thẻ, điện thoại; hai phe.

Riêng tư và kiểm soát: tiền giấy không cần điện, thấy chi tiêu; ví dụ người mang số tiền cố định ra chợ mỗi tuần thấy còn bao nhiêu ít chi quá; không để dấu vết số; người không tài khoản (trẻ, du khách, già); mất điện, sự cố; tránh phí thẻ tiểu thương.

Nhanh, có hồ sơ: thẻ, ứng dụng nhanh, an toàn khỏi trộm, dễ theo dõi nhưng phụ thuộc công nghệ; ví dụ du khách trả bằng điện thoại ở nước ngoài khỏi mang nhiều tiền, đổi tiền; nhân viên không đếm tiền thối; sao kê giúp ngân sách, khó trốn thuế; mua online, chuyển tức thì; nhược: tấn công mạng, sự cố, chi quá; có cả hai; số hằng ngày, tiền mặt dự phòng.
Ưu số hằng ngày nhưng tiền mặt vẫn được chấp nhận.
